in_hebrew.name: אַכְכַלְיָה

in_greek.name: Ακκαλία
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word ἀκκλητος (akkletos), which means 'honor', 'nobility', 'purity'. This name can be interpreted as 'The Honored One' or 'The Noble One'.
